card.name: Words inside quoted scripture and old texts
card.fires_on: Ordinary words (our, an, out, had, commas) inside quoted Bible verses, religious commentary, or archaic and dictionary-style passages. It is not tied to one word, but to the old or scriptural setting.

modes.label: Bible quotations
modes.description: Small words in the middle of a quoted verse in King James style.
modes.example: Thou art<< our>> sister, be thou the mother of thousands

modes.label: Religious commentary
modes.description: Words in church-history or theology prose that cites scripture, including parts of the word antichrist.
modes.example: as ye have heard that antich<<rist>> shall come, even now are there many

modes.label: Dictionary and Latin entries
modes.description: Punctuation or word endings in etymology notes and Latin text.
